raw_supervision: All 11 action labels at three prior exposures; legacy 4096 replay versus full replay, identical input order and update budget
factor_supervision: Two mature market return components per distinct asset/period, 35 market-only inputs. Exact same funded cash/fee engine converts forecasts to action values. Log forecasts are scenarios, not calibrated expected cash returns.
decision_rule: Choose a different action only when its modeled net log return exceeds the reference by .10 percentage points. All learned arms share this rule.
allocation: Equal fixed funded sleeves across eight present-selected symbols; not a full-universe qualification
expert_selection: Best training-only net portfolio return among all 11 fixed experts; alphabetical tie. No later returns read.
override_gate: Before 2025 audit: economic overlay must beat its training-selected expert on BOTH earlier development folds AND market forecast MSE must beat training-mean forecasts on BOTH. Otherwise retain the expert. No learned profit credit for expert fallback.
limitations: All dates are previously inspected development history
Daily reference-open simulation, no exchange fill claim
More epochs are not more independent market evidence
